name: Suvarna Sanchay
tagline: Start small, shine big — your 11-month journey to gold.
benefits: 20% bonus gold on plan completion — for every ₹10,000 saved, you get ₹2,000 worth of gold free
Zero interest — entirely bonus-based, making it fully Shariah-compliant and interest-free
Flexible installment dates — pay anytime within the month without penalty
Free lifetime maintenance on all jewellery purchased through the scheme
Option to upgrade to a higher plan at any time by adjusting the difference
terms: Minimum monthly installment of ₹1,000; maximum no upper limit
Scheme runs for 11 consecutive months
Bonus gold is credited only upon successful completion of all 11 installments
Default in more than 2 installments will result in forfeiture of bonus
Gold will be issued at the prevailing market rate on the date of settlement
Only individuals aged 18 years and above are eligible
Scheme is non-transferable and non-refundable before maturity

name: Mangala
tagline: Plan your wedding gold with our 21-month auspicious savings plan.
benefits: 25% bonus gold on successful completion of the plan
Perfect for bridal trousseau planning — accumulate gold in time for the wedding
Free exclusive bridal consultation with our in-house designers
5% discount on making charges for all jewellery purchases through the scheme
Priority access to new bridal collection launches
Option to withdraw gold in phases before the wedding date
terms: Minimum monthly installment of ₹1,500; maximum no upper limit
Scheme duration is 21 consecutive months
Bonus is applicable only on full completion of all installments
Early withdrawal allowed after 12 months with reduced bonus of 15%
Missing 3 or more installments voids the bonus offer
Gold rate for settlement will be the average of the last 3 months of the scheme
One account per PAN card permitted under this scheme

name: Shree
tagline: Build a substantial gold corpus over 3 years with maximum rewards.
benefits: 30% bonus gold at maturity — the highest bonus across all our schemes
Suitable for long-term gold investment and wealth building
Complimentary gold coin (1g) at the halfway mark (18 months)
Free jewellery insurance for one year on purchases made through the scheme
Dedicated relationship manager for the duration of the plan
10% discount on special festival collections during Diwali and Raja
Family pooling allowed — multiple family members can contribute to a single plan
terms: Minimum monthly installment of ₹2,000; maximum no upper limit
Scheme runs for 36 consecutive months
Full 30% bonus is payable only upon completion of all 36 installments
Partial closure allowed after 24 months with a reduced bonus of 20%
A grace period of 7 days per month is allowed for late payments
More than 5 missed installments across the term will cancel the bonus
Gold will be delivered in the form of jewellery, coins, or bars at the customer's choice
TDS applicable on bonus value as per prevailing income tax rules
